pages.text: $(l)Cataclysm$(): Ignis in the Burning Arena and the Netherite Monstrosity at the Soul Black Smith, both in the Nether; the Ender Guardian in the Ruined Citadel; the Leviathan in the Sunken City; the Ancient Remnant in the Cursed Pyramid; Maledictus in the Frosted Prison; Scylla at the Acropolis; the Harbinger in the Ancient Factory.

$(l)Mass Destruction$(): the Lich's tower in the cold; the Obsidilith in the End; the Gauntlet in the Nether; the Void Blossom deep in lush caves.$(br2)$(l)Mowzie's$(): the Ferrous Wroughtnaut in its chamber underground; Frostmaw asleep in the snow; Umvuthi in its grove; the Sculptor atop a mountain monastery.
$(l)Soulslike Weaponry$(): the Decaying King in the Nether; Old Champion's Remains at the Champion's Graves; the Returning Knight answers a Lost Soul placed on the Old Moon Altar in the Cathedral.

$(l)Aquamirae$(): blow a shell horn by the water in the Ice Maze and Captain Cornelia comes. $(l)The Graveyard$(): wake the Corrupted Champion at the Lich Prison, at night, with a vial of blood and the three bone staff pieces.
